notes.content:

With this update, the new Contracts mechanic is introduced. Contracts are missions and challenges that need to be completed. Upon completing a contract, new items are unlocked. In the main menu, you can view all contract missions and claim the reward as soon as you have completed a contract. Some players had requested an expanded metaprogression system, and the contracts mechanic is designed to enhance this. Additionally, it holds potential for various endgame challenges. New contract missions will be added with the upcoming updates.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44251755/1c1024a00ccd1e7fa2bb3b0278b175b429988751.jpg

This update includes some balancing changes and bug fixes. Furthermore, there is now the possibility to mark specific crew professions as "required." Found crew members whose professions have been marked as required will be highlighted with a star icon. This way, you can more easily identify which crew members are needed in your colony ship. To use this feature check out the "Required Professions" tab in the colony ship. Several players have requested such a feature, and I'm happy to give you what you wish for.

You can also check out the new content. A new ship and weapon can be researched in the colony ship.

There was alot of constructive feedback. Thank you very much for that! I'm working hard to address all the suggestions and expand the game according to the community's vision.

Feel free to post your feedback on our Discord server. The feedback of the community is very important in the process of creating this game. Feature requests and a supportive dialogue with the players is much appreciated.

notes.title: Light Speed Ride Out v0.27 is live!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44251755/1c1024a00ccd1e7fa2bb3b0278b175b429988751.jpg

Thank you very much for your feedback! Many players have requested a redesign of the stats window. I have divided the stats into categories and sorted them alphabetically. I hope this will make it easier to find individual stats. Furthermore, there has been a request to increase the chance of active part rolls in the first sectors.

New Escape Pod Mechanics:
Escape pods are used when your ship is destroyed to safely transport crew members to the colony. The number of escape pods can be increased through passive items. This way, your colony can continue to grow even if your mission fails. Each ship starts with one escape pod designated for the captain.

New Scrap Container Ship Mechanic:
Scrap container ships will rarely spawn in any sectors. These ships transport a larger amount of scrap. Try to destroy them to access the resources.

notes.title: Light Speed Ride Out - Roadmap July 2023
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44251755/d14501a98bbc67c3ef645d97a500798848c94931.jpg

I am offering a glimpse into the exciting updates and features planned for the near future. This roadmap showcases my commitment to continuously improve the game and deliver a captivating space survival experience for you players. From bug fixes and performance enhancements to new ships, technologies, and in-game events, there's something for everyone as we strive to create an immersive and dynamic gameplay environment.

In the upcoming period, my primary focus will be on addressing bugs and inconveniences to ensure a smoother and more enjoyable gameplay experience. Rest assured, I am also dedicated to creating exciting new content. Stay tuned for a ton of new features, enhancements, and surprises that will keep you engaged and eager to explore the depths of space.

Weekly Content Updates
Each week, I will release at least one new ship, along with new technologies, weapons, gadgets and engines. 
Next ships to come:
Valkyrie, a fast jet with alot of firepower
Hauler, a heavy carrier
Helios, a ship with dynamic active slots

July 2023

 Bug fixes
 Balancing (e.g. Increase the chances of getting active parts on the first sectors)
 Improved controller menu navigation
 Quality of life changes
 Performance improvements
 New in-game events for more decision-making opportunities
 Expansion of the in-game tutorials
 Adding another way to get colonists

Join our Official Discord
I'd like to invite all players to join our official Discord community to provide feedback, share suggestions for new content, and engage with other players. Your input plays a vital role in shaping the future of Light Speed Ride Out.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44251755/cc3a253b86e24aa17c5082359adec1240d08a1cc.png

Note: The roadmap presented above outlines the updates and patches planned for the near future. Please note that the roadmap is subject to change based on development priorities and community feedback. I appreciate your continued support and look forward to delivering an exciting and evolving gaming experience.

I hope you have fun playing Light Speed Ride Out. Stay tuned!
-brimsel

notes.title: Light Speed Ride Out - Early Access available now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44251755/0357a4984ef8e5f0d9822700a496a2a99e15422f.jpg

In "Light Speed Ride Out" players will find themselves immersed in a vast and dangerous galaxy, facing relentless hordes of enemies. It's a battle for survival where quick reflexes, cunning strategies, and a touch of luck are the keys to triumph. Upgrade your ship with an array of powerful items, customize your loadout, and unleash devastating attacks as you navigate through epic space battles.

However, the challenges don't end there. Assemble the crew of your ship, make crucial decisions, and rescue people to join your space colony. Each decision counts as you strive to create a thriving community amidst the perils of deep space. Will you be a beacon of hope in the darkest corners of the universe?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44251755/dda5f8102f0262200b91a182c5a05f150619637c.jpg

I have learned a lot about the game during the demo phase. Thank you so much for your time and feedback. I am working hard to continuously improve the game. The early access version differs significantly from the free demo that was available until July 1st. In addition to numerous bug fixes and quality of life changes, there is a lot of new content.

5 levels of difficulty
9 totally different ships (Jets, heavy space stations, powerful alien ships, and much more...)
4 new bosses to defeat
Over 100 different items to equip
20 different weapons to unlock
9 different engines to unlock
91 achievements to master
New colony ship
Succeed on your mission to get your crew to join your colony ship
Manage your colony to unlock new technologies, items and ships
New space academy
Ship captains gain experience and can be trained in the space academy
Improved short in-game tutorials to better explain the game's mechanics while playing

There is a lot to discover and even more possibilities for your own complex builds. There will be regular patches and content updates in the near future. Additionally, I will release a detailed roadmap in the coming days. I wish you a lot of fun playing!
